meta.use_when: You need a one-on-one messaging panel with a contact header, bubbles, and a composer.
meta.not_for: you need a list of conversations alongside the open thread, not just the single open thread → list-detail; the messages are one-way system alerts, not a two-way conversation with someone → notifications

docs: A one-on-one messaging panel — contact header, message bubbles, and a composer input. Do: Align the current user's messages to one side (right) and the other party's to the other (left) — position is the primary cue for who said what. Don't: Rely on color alone to distinguish sender — pair it with consistent alignment. Use list-detail when you need a list of conversations alongside the open thread, not just the single open thread. Use notifications when the messages are one-way system alerts, not a two-way conversation with someone.
